ledger.note: 31 August 1962: Trinidad and Tobago becomes independent. 'Trinidad and Tobago gained its independence from the United Kingdom on 31 August 1962.' Second page (West Indies Federation): the PNM rejected further involvement with the Federation on 14 January 1962 and the Federation was dissolved on 31 May 1962; the page's own infobox ends the island's Federation province at 14 January 1962. The matching loss belongs in the British Colonial Empire dossier.

1 August 1976: the state becomes a republic within the Commonwealth. Infobox 'Republic: 1 August 1976'; 'In 1976 the country became a republic within the Commonwealth.' Same state, same land, same colour; Cliopatria's Name 'Republic of Trinidad and Tobago' is used from 1963.

certainty.note: An island state: the coast is the frontier. The page records no land boundary and no territorial change; the maritime boundaries with Venezuela and Barbados are not on the page opened (no event coded).

notes: Page budget 2 of 2 (Trinidad and Tobago, West Indies Federation). Cliopatria's shape starts 1963; independence was 31 August 1962, hence the new keyframe for 1962. The British Colonial Empire shape holds the islands to 1962 and loses them in 1963: the eu-11 dossier should carry the matching loss in August 1962. The West Indies Federation (3 January 1958 to 31 May 1962; Port of Spain its de facto capital) is not a Cliopatria row; its dossier west-indies-federation was written in parallel and lists this state as a successor. Disagreement between pages: the T&T infobox ends the Federation province on 14 January 1962 (the PNM resolution), the Federation page gives the Federation's dissolution as 31 May 1962; both are recorded. Only the year (1990) is given for the Jamaat al Muslimeen coup attempt, which moved no border; the page does not mention Venezuela's maritime treaty or the Barbados arbitration, so no contest is coded although Cliopatria's neighbour list has Venezuela 1963-2024 (within 25 km). The islands' earlier history (1797 capitulation, 1802 cession, 1889 union) is before the state's life and sits in the predecessor note. The page gives no ruler list. Reviewer am-08-j (2026-10-19): west-indies-federation moved out of predecessors, which list the states whose land this state took at its birth: the island's Federation province ended on 14 January 1962 (infobox 'Province of the West Indies Federation: 3 January 1958 - 14 January 1962') and the Federation was disestablished on 31 May 1962 (Federation infobox), so on 31 August 1962 the land came from the British colony. Port of Spain was the Federation's de facto capital ('In practice, Port of Spain served as the de facto federal capital', Federation page).
